name: EU VAT Validator for WooCommerce
author: protoolkit

sections.description:
EU VAT Validator for WooCommerce helps stores validate VAT numbers during checkout using the official VIES SOAP service.

Features:

  • VAT number field at checkout
  • VIES validation via the official EU VIES SOAP API
  • Automatic reverse charge for valid B2B orders
  • VAT validation result saved on orders
  • No phone-home tracking
  • Completely free, no upsells
sections.installation:
1. Upload the woo-eu-vat-validator folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Test checkout with a valid EU VAT number.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send data to third-party services?

Only the VAT number validation request to the official EU VIES SOAP endpoint is made. This is core functionality.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes. WooCommerce must be active.

Where can I find more plugins?

Check out protoolkit.net for our other free WooCommerce plugins.
